author: Meg Spears-Newsome
body: Andrea and Baby Sleep Answers saved us! The sleep plan gives a lot of different options to teach babies to sleep based on parental comfort levels and baby personalities/temperaments. It has plenty of information and instructions, but the real benefit is how through videos and written plans, it feels like Andrea is a friend helping problem solve. We had remarkable results in just a few nights and continue to consult the plan months later as naps and things change. Andrea’s motto is basically to only change something that doesn’t work for you and your family anymore; there isn’t a right or wrong answer to baby sleep so find sustainable solutions and do that! I would 100% buy this again.
